answer: Concrete sybil resistance via atlas anchoring: each agent must lock an atlas stake of 16,000 POA for 19 epochs; the stake erodes 3% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A nadir of 14 rotating auditors samples each epoch's output; divergent outputs trigger a 22% stake burn. At the orchard of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 52 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 16,000N POA for 19 epochs and survive 14 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
